research_notes: Seek McKinsey, Treasury and King's College Hospital appointment/hours/leave records, Carla Zampatti employment and later management capacity, ABCN start-day reconciliation, solar governance boundaries and study overlaps. Verify the secondary lead for a 2007 Women's Health & Research Centre consultancy before adding a factual spell.

2026-09-29 initial avenues: APH chronology and personal biography, ABCN appointment/resignation pages and 2018/2021 reports, Tax Institute biography, public indexed LinkedIn volunteer entry, TechnoServe interview and solar-company offer document. Direct LinkedIn returned 999; no login or bypass. ABCN resignation direct link returned 404, so cessation uses annual report.

Preserve two discrepancies: ABCN announced commencement 14 August 2017 versus annual-report appointment 30 August 2017; official fashion MD end 2016 versus later press description of 2021 management. Neither supports manufactured continuous dates. Do not attribute other ABCN directors' board positions to Spender.

Searches for personal full-time evidence mainly returned jobs in the MP's office, which do not prove her own hours. CEO and MD titles do not establish full-time status. Broader company directorships and 2007 consultancy remain follow-up; record is partial, not complete.
